types.description: A coordinating parent; its outcome is achieved through children.

minimum_evidence.note: the project-management system says this item is an Epic
child items already exist under it

types.description: A capability that does not exist yet.

minimum_evidence.note: no capability record intersects the described behaviour and no code implements it, which is what separates a FEATURE from a DEFECT

types.description: A bounded slice of a feature, independently completable.

minimum_evidence.note: the project-management system says this item is a Story
or the described slice resolves to paths that exist, which bounds it
the capability being complained about exists; a complaint about something never built is not a defect

types.description: Bounded work making no capability claim: a chore, a config change, documentation, cleanup.

minimum_evidence.note: the work names something that exists, which is what makes it bounded

types.description: Production is wrong right now; containment precedes correctness.

minimum_evidence.note: nobody declares an incident by writing the word. A user report is not a runtime observation, however urgent it sounds; if a runtime probe later observes the failure, the kernel records a re-resolution and the type is upgraded with evidence

types.description: The deliverable is understanding; change is not assumed.

minimum_evidence.note: an investigation asserts nothing about the system, so it needs no evidence to be admissible. Its template mutates nothing, which is what makes that safe

types.description: A proposed change already exists and the outcome is that it lands. An orphan PR - one serving no work item AgentOS knows about - resolves here.

minimum_evidence.note: the pull request or patch it is about exists and was read through the adapter

types.description: Resolution did not establish a type. Routes to investigation.readonly, which is the safe thing to do when you do not know what you are looking at.

minimum_evidence.note: UNKNOWN is what a type asserted without its minimum evidence is downgraded to, so it can require none. The claimed type is recorded
